messages:
maria: quick proposal: add permission `dsar.erase.invoke` to the privacy-service role so it can trigger the keystore delete-worker. before i open the PR, i want to confirm auditing and KMS proof needs.
ajay: sounds reasonable. what evidence do we keep after the delete completes? legal usually wants an artifact list for any retention-exception.
olivia: for legal we need: requestor verification log, erase-job id, KMS op id(s), and a short evidence retention window. prefer approval step for multi-region erasures.
maria: implementation note: evidence bundle will contain metadata only (no raw payload). plan to store `object_hash` (sha256), `object_meta` (size/type), `pre_delete_snapshot_id`, `erase_job_id`, and `kms_op_id`. keep bundle encrypted and TTL-limited.
nate: KMS caveat: if keys have rotated, CloudKMS audit entries still reference `cryptoKeyVersions`. capture those version ids in the evidence bundle so we can correlate. also ensure audit logs include the public operation id but not raw plaintext.
ajay: good — also confirm we redact customer content from evidence. hashes + metadata are fine. legal doesn't need the payload.
maria: agreed. no payload in evidence. evidence JSON will include `kms_key_versions` and `kms_operation_ids` arrays. store in a restricted evidence bucket with server-side encryption + restricted ACLs and short TTL (21d) unless flagged for legal hold.
ajay: what about cross-region snapshot copies? delete-worker today only deletes local snapshots. do we want privacy-service to be able to call cross-region purge?
maria: not in this change. keep cross-region purge behind a separate admin workflow that requires reviewer approval and an explicit retention-exception flag. we can implement a fanout job that runs after manual approval.
olivia: +1 on manual reviewer approval for multi-region. reduces risk and makes the chain of custody auditable.
nate: technical: add a smoke test for rotated-key scenarios that verifies `cryptoKeyVersions` get captured and the audit entry has the op id. also test replaying evidence lookups does not leak plaintext.
maria: test matrix i plan to include in the PR: 1) RBAC sim proving privacy-service can call `dsar.erase.invoke` but cannot call `cross-region-purge`, 2) audit log assertion test to check required fields (`erase_job_id`,`kms_op_id`,`requestor_id`), 3) evidence TTL and SSE encryption verification, 4) smoke for rotated-key path. will paste the matrix in the PR.
ajay: i'll draft a DSAR QA checklist and an example evidence package schema for legal review.
olivia: once i see the evidence schema + tests and the reviewer gating for cross-region, i'll sign off on the limited RBAC addition. mark any retention-exception as needing legal reviewer.
deploy-bot: keystore-delete-worker v2 pipeline queued: build #482 -> staging -> canary
maria: thanks — i'll open the PR in ~1.5h and tag @ajay @nate @olivia. planning to include the RBAC diff, test matrix, sample evidence JSON, and the reviewer-approval flow for cross-region operations.
ajay: thanks — will review when up. :thumbsup:
olivia: watching for the PR. please call out the exact TTL wording and the legal-hold override in the description.
